title: Reading part of a file
hints: os.Open returns an *os.File. Close it with defer once you know Open succeeded.
f.ReadAt(buf, offset) reads len(buf) bytes starting at offset without moving the file position. Near the end of the file it returns fewer bytes along with io.EOF.
io.EOF just means you hit the end, so return string(buf[:n]) with no error in that case. Any other error should be returned.
